contentList.content: Drake walking animation fix script cheese

Your connection to the natural world takes the form of a draconic spirit, which can manifest in physical form as a drake. As your powers grow, your drake grows as well, blossoming from a small four-legged companion to a majestic, winged creature large and strong enough for you to ride. Along the way, you gain an increasing share of the awe-inspiring power of dragons.
You can magically summon the drake that is bound to you. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within [1] of you.
A ferocious attack with claws and fangs.

When another creature within [1] of the drake that it can see hits a target with a weapon attack, the drake infuses the strike with its essence, causing the target to take an extra 1d6 damage of the type determined by its Draconic Essence.
When another creature within [1] of the drake that it can see hits a target with a weapon attack, the drake infuses the strike with its essence, causing the target to take an extra [2].

When either you or the drake takes damage while you're within [1] of each other, you can use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to give yourself or the drake <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> to that instance of damage.

As an action, you can exhale a cone of damaging breath or cause your drake to exhale it. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (your choice doesn't have to match your drake's Draconic Essence). Each creature in the cone must make a Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> against your spell save DC, taking half damage on a successful save.

Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (your choice doesn't have to match your drake's Draconic Essence). Each creature in the blast area must make a Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> against your spell save DC, taking 8d6 damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This damage increases to 10d6 when you reach 15th level in Drakewarden.

Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (your choice doesn't have to match your drake's Draconic Essence). Each creature in the cone must make a Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> against your spell save DC, taking [1] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> against your spell save DC, taking half damage on a successful save.

The bond you share with your drake intensifies, protecting you and stoking the drake's fury. The drake's Bite attack deals an extra 1d6 damage of the type chosen for the drake's Draconic Essence. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> to the damage type chosen for the drake's Draconic Essence.
You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> to the damage type chosen for the drake's Draconic Essence.
Your bonded drake's damage bonus is increased by 1d6 (to a total of 2d6) and it grows larger. You also gain Reflexive Resistance.
You gain the aid of a draconic familiar, which might be a splinter of the consciousness of a dragon that invested you with power.
You gain the power to become a Dragonborn.
Echoes of a dragon's might linger around you, and you can call on them to inspire fear in those who stand against you.
Become a will-o'-wisp to better traverse terrain. Emits light.
Dismiss your will-o'-wisp shape and turn back into your original form.
Hover in the air to avoid touching the ground. Makes you immune to most <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DIFFICULT_TERRAIN">difficult terrains</LSTag> such as grease, web, and vines.
Beat your draconic wings and take flight, carrying a bonded Drakewarden with you.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> Once you use this feature, you can’t do so again until you finish a <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">long rest</LSTag>, unless you expend a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag> of 3rd level or higher to use it again.
Expend a [1] level <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag> to use your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_DrakeBreath_Drakewarden">Drake's Breath</LSTag> ability.
Drakewardens can magically summon the drake that is bound to them once per long rest or by expending spell slots.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> Once you use this feature, you can’t do so again until you finish a <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">long rest</LSTag>, unless you expend a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag> of 1st level or higher to use it again.
The pinacle of a Drakewarden's bond to their drake allows them to reduce damage dealt to each other.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.
